description.narrative: Employment support through vocational training and income support to 400 refugees and host communities affected by Azerbaijan aggression on Nagorno-Karabakh in September 2023.
Sysselsättningsskapande åtgärder i form av betald arbetsträning för 400 flyktingar och värdsamhällen drabbade av Azerbadzjans aggression mot Nagorno-Karabakh i september 2023.

Main objective The proposed project aims at rehabilitating the livelihood systems of the groups in the most vulnerable situations among the refugees from NK and the host communities in a way that meets core humanitarian standards and minimum economic recovery standards [Minimum Economic Recovery Standards, Humanitarian Standard Partnership, third edition, the SEEP Network, 2017].
This will contribute to increasing refugees protection levels, expanding their access to socioeconomic rights and opportunities, decreasing their dependence on humanitarian aid, reestablishing a sense of normalcy in their lives and diminishing the pressure on public budgets and host communities generous hospitality.
Expected output Livelihood systems of the groups in the most vulnerable situations among the refugees from NK and the host communities are rehabilitated.
Expected results indicators Implement active labor market policy (ALMP) instruments to facilitate employability and employment
a) Update of Labor Market Study (2020)
b) It is expected that up to 400 peoples employability will be considerably enhanced, while around 200 of them will be offered decent job opportunities by their prospective employers. As a result, 1.600 people, members of beneficiaries respective households, will be able to count on a steady income source to meet their needs for three months and up to 800 of them (50 percent of trained workers household members) will be able to count on a steady income from long term, sustainable employment.

8.6 - Till 2020 väsentligt minska den andel ungdomar som varken arbetar eller studerar.
